messages:
marie.sales: Heads-up — Prospect (NovoHealth) requested a 7-day eval and wants a single evidence bundle (SOC2 + ISO + vendor pen-test) uploaded to our dataroom. They asked for the raw pen-test PDF plus an attestation letter. Who can own ingestion and retention?
ada.sec: Raw is fine but only via presigned upload. Must have a vendor-signed attestation that explicitly permits storage and sharing with named auditors. Also need an explicit redaction SLA.
tom.ops: We can provision a scoped presign under `novo/evidence/` and set object lifecycle to 21 days. Presign TTL 5 days to force quick upload. We can enable prefix-level audit logs and MFA-delete on request.
marie.sales: Buyer also asked if Redwood can act as vendor-liaison to get the signature (timezones). Is that a service we can offer and how do we price it?
rachel.legal: We can provide vendor-liaison under a short SOW. Attestation should include a custodian clause: Redwood stores evidence as custodian for the retention period; vendor remains responsible for report content. I'll draft a retention/redaction matrix.
kevin.eng: For POC compute: we can reserve a canary dedicated slot free on day 0; reproducing findings on reserved nodes will be an add-on. Recommended quiet scan window: Sun 02:00-05:00 UTC to minimize interference.
ada.sec: Please include this attestation snippet in the vendor letter:

```
Attestation matrix:
- Scope: explicit staging CIDRs/hostnames and listed container registries
- Retention: Redwood retains raw reports for 21 days (region per customer request)
- Redaction SLA: Customer may request redaction within 7 days; Redwood will apply redaction and re-issue a redacted bundle within 48 hours
- Distribution: Vendor permits sharing with customer-designated auditors only
- Custody & exports: Redwood acts solely as custodian; vendor must declare any export/control constraints
```

tom.ops: ops-bot: presign-ready: https://dataroom.redwood.test/presign/novo-evidence?ttl=5d (example). Generated at 4300000100. :white_check_mark:
marie.sales: I'll add quote lines: "POC reserved compute", "Evidence ingestion & retention (21d)", "Vendor-liaison (optional)", "Redaction service (optional)". Note: EU residency adds a small uplift to storage pricing.
rachel.legal: Draft attestation uploaded to the dataroom; tagging @ada.sec for security sign-off. Added limited-liability language for vendor-liaison.
kevin.eng: Confirmed canary slot and proposed scan window. Ops to confirm dedicated node pricing if buyer requests reproduction capacity.
marie.sales: Next steps: legal send attestation to vendor, ops confirm final presign URL, sales finalize quote and SOW if vendor-liaison requested. Will close when vendor signs. Thanks all. :pray:
